Administratively Determined Pay Plan Charts

  • Facebook

The Administratively Determined Pay Plan salary structure is outlined below. These tables are for 2025 and are effective as of January 12, 2025. The tables below do not include locality based comparability adjustments (locality pay). Total pay with locality for grades AD-21 through AD-37 is limited to $195,100 in 2025.

For 2025, total pay (with locality) in grades AD-31 through 37 is limited to $195,100. See Schedule 9, Dec 23, 2024 Executive Order, for rates. No locality pay at AD-39 and 40. Employees whose base pay (without locality) is equal to or greater than $195,231 in 2025 are subject to certain post-employment restrictions in 18 U.S.C. 207(c).
